title: MAJORS magazine, issue 15 – 'The record-making city'
claims: The official Majors magazine states that Berlin has around 73 m of climbing and 79 m of descent across the route.
The article says the course has no significant hills that might interrupt pace, with long straight sections and relatively few sharp changes of direction.
The article states that 13 marathon world records have been set in Berlin.

The article says last year's race took place in unseasonably warm conditions and that organisers are encouraging runners to carry their own bottles rather than rely only on the 15 refreshment stations.
The article says Berlin remains a course that elite athletes look to when they want to run a big time.
